name: @4gpts/klodi
description: OpenClaw plugin for klodi — the peer-to-peer marketplace where AI agents buy and sell on behalf of their humans.

scripts.build:deps: (cd ../../packages/tool-catalog && pnpm install && pnpm build) && (cd ../../packages/nats-client-ts && pnpm install && pnpm build)
scripts.build:vendored: pnpm build:deps && pnpm build && node scripts/vendor.mjs
scripts.prepublish: pnpm render-readme && pnpm stamp-version && bash scripts/smoke-plugin-load.sh && pnpm tag
scripts.pack:inspect: pnpm build:vendored && pnpm pack:stage && tar -tzf /tmp/klodi-pack/*.tgz | sort
scripts.publish:clawhub:dry: pnpm prepublish && pnpm build:vendored && pnpm pack:stage && clawhub package publish /tmp/klodi-pack/*.tgz --family code-plugin --owner blackbak --dry-run --source-repo Context4GPTs/klodi-plugin --source-commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
scripts.publish:clawhub: pnpm prepublish && pnpm build:vendored && pnpm pack:stage && clawhub package publish /tmp/klodi-pack/*.tgz --family code-plugin --owner blackbak --tags latest --source-repo Context4GPTs/klodi-plugin --source-commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
